scope: Five actual batch-one Agent tasks: short text, encrypted memory seed, recall after a fresh-controller DPAPI reopen, and English/Chinese loopback browser open/read tasks. This headless functional run does not establish Qt UI, general browser/Windows tools, visual-model, memory quality, performance, memory-cap or release qualification.

identity.source_scope: full captured before/after working-tree hash equality plus selected current source bytes; preserved unrelated dirty files prevent clean-commit assertion

task_measurement_scope: five individual functional samples; request/model/SSE durations exclude separately measured cold startup verification; no p50/p95 or Qt rendering TTFT

native_compute_scope: Native DONE counters prove routed decode expert entries on CPU/CUDA only; no whole-model or all-operator compute claim.
memory_verification_scope: Independent read-only SQLite reopen and user-scoped DPAPI authentication, metadata/content/kind HMAC and provenance-index checks, original observed seed in the actual recalled model prompt, distinct sessions and persisted final provenance. All actual Agent events were matched to decrypted records without changing database bytes. Private contents and identifiers remain unpublished.
browser_verification_scope: Real guarded headless Microsoft Edge open/read results matched their controlled loopback sources and pinned EN/ZH references; actual neural prompts contained those untrusted observations. No approved writes, general website interactions or open-web safety qualification.

controllers.startup_scope: Fresh native process startup plus full artifact verification, including hashing; not isolated model-load or cold physical SSD latency.

selected_module_scope: Verified engine, bundled cuBLAS libraries and System32 CUDA driver at each load; not all OS modules or continuous dependency behavior.

dependency_fingerprints.scope: captured identity preimage canonical hash and environment binding checked; selected current sources rehashed; vLLM/contract package trees not rehashed by independent auditor

telemetry.scope: separate sampled WDDM local/nonlocal accounting; nonlocal overlaps host RAM; loading/transient/hard-cap/whole-device power unverified

getter_scope: per-call saved last-I/O equals terminal evidence; closed-controller retained getter equals last call; retired live getters not invoked
plan_immutability_scope: all saved request evidence refers to the same per-controller full load plan; exact runner checked wrapper/client plan equality per request; no independent second post-request plan snapshot

shutdown.scope: runner saved thread/reference/driver-returncode observations plus independently absent wrappers/native owners; no exact browser child PID inventory saved for independent child-process enumeration

measurement_conditions.cache: existing caches; model/pack/runtime rehashed at load; not a cold-disk experiment
measurement_conditions.timing: cold process/load separately timed; single functional samples only, no p50/p95
measurement_conditions.gpu_loading_peak: unverified; exact process observer bound after load
measurement_conditions.browser: real ephemeral headless Microsoft Edge, loopback-only guarded tools
measurement_conditions.tool_policy: browser_open/browser_read only; no general internet, approval, Windows setting or write tools

limitations: loopback read-only EN/ZH fixture success does not qualify general browser/Windows tools or tool safety beyond this scope
DPAPI integrity/provenance and one reopened recall do not qualify general long-term memory quality
sampler observes separate WDDM local/nonlocal values, not loading/transient hard caps or physical SSD traffic
power conditions are snapshots; whole-device power and sustained stability remain unverified
Each task has one functional sample. Request, model-call, first visible SSE and cold startup/verification boundaries are separate; no p50/p95 or paired baseline is inferred.
Full loaded Agent dependency identity preimage is captured and its digest/environment binding is recomputed; the independent audit does not rehash entire vLLM and stage-contract package trees.
Before/after source snapshots are actual local working-tree identities and include preserved unrelated dirty files; no clean-commit or independent rebuild assertion.
The exact runner observed thread/browser reference/driver-returncode shutdown. Retired wrappers/native owners were independently absent; no exact browser child PID inventory was saved.
Per-request evidence uses one immutable saved load plan per controller; the exact runner checked live equality, but no independent second post-request plan snapshot was captured.
Sampled WDDM local/nonlocal memory must remain separate; nonlocal overlaps host RAM. Loading peaks, file-cache residency, aggregate hard caps and model-attributed physical SSD bytes remain unknown.
Telemetry timestamps are monotonic in this run, but no chronological or time-integrated power analysis is qualified.
